Upper Text: If 2 such cards are linked together, stack the link card on top and digivolve.

[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By linking 1 [Appmon] trait Digimon card from your hand or this Digimon's digivolution cards to this Digimon without paying the cost, 1 of your Digimon may unsuspend.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon gets linked or unsuspends, until your turn ends, this Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ and ＜Blocker＞, and your opponent's Digimon effects don't affect it.
